Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Lake Tahoe hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 18 Lake Tahoe hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 8 and Agoda at 3. These are the Lake Tahoe rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 11 of the 17 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 8, Agoda at 3, Clicktrip.com at 1, Hotels In America at 1 and Priceline at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 6, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: the study also counts the 1 named below that are not listed on this page. Each hotel below shows every site's all-in price. Across all cities: which booking site was lowest most often, measured.

Taxes and fees at Lake Tahoe hotels

At the 15 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 17% ($18 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 12% at Cedar Glen Lodge to 20% at Harrah's Lake Tahoe - A Caesars Rewards Destination. At 2 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
